programs.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
programs.desc: Tom Hardy returns as Marvel's gnarly antihero, to face a symbiote spawned from Venom's own blood living inside a serial killer who looks just like Woody Harrelson. Yikes.

programs.title: Snake Eyes
programs.desc: Violent martial arts action. A brooding cage fighter (Henry Golding) is contracted to assassinate a target but saves him instead, so that he can infiltrate an ancient ninja society.

programs.title: In the Earth
programs.desc: Ben Wheatley's horror with Reece Shearsmith. When a key scientist goes missing during a pandemic, the search for her is foiled by a strange and mystical man living deep in the woods.

programs.title: Destroyer
programs.desc: Second World War drama about a warship assigned to mail runs but that ends up engaged in battle anyway, starring Edward G Robinson, Glenn Ford and Marguerite Chapman.
